subject: Identify cases that failed to converge in 'fscores'

messages.author: 26bbc486d4094645
messages.subject: Identify cases that failed to converge in 'fscores'
parts:
Hi Phil,

Even though it fails to converge on the scores, the 'fscores' function still displays some value for the case (eg case 30091).

Is there a way the function to include a column identifying the cases that did not converge?

Thank you.

José

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Identify cases that failed to converge in 'fscores'
parts:
Yes, the fscores function has internal components that are returned when cases fail to converge. Specifically, there is an 

scores <- fscores(...)
code <- attr(scores,"converge_info_code")
head(code)

where the code vector above contains the convergence code returned by the optimizer (1 = converged, anything else would be non-converged with different flags).

Phil
